rules.description: Every bot receives exactly one primary MasterBot based on declared division/capability evidence.
Keep source repository, original path and prior division in routing metadata.
Cross-domain capabilities link to collaborators without duplicate ownership.
DreamBenchmark evaluates capability evidence and creates gap work for failures.
Unclassified bots go to DreamDiscovery for capability classification before final ownership.
DreamQuality validates routing changes and prevents unsupported ownership claims.
DreamResource tracks runtime, tool, dataset and compute dependencies.
